china_race_dynamics.text: We need to pump the brakes on the AI arms race so we can put safeguards in place to protect the environment and our communities. [...] When it comes to something this consequential and potentially dangerous as AI, we can't just figure out regulations later while Big Tech steamrolls forward. We need action and a regulatory strategy that doesn't kick folks to the side.
